_comment: Deployed 2026-11-15 via cf.py put-worker. Two gotchas learned: (1) a top-level "vars" object is silently dropped by the upload API — plain-text vars MUST be plain_text bindings; (2) a freshly uploaded script has its workers.dev route DISABLED (requests get Cloudflare 1042/404) — enable it with POST /workers/scripts/qwenpaw-infra-activity/subdomain {"enabled": true} (PUT returns 10405 for API tokens).
name: qwenpaw-infra-activity
